clock._comment_max_turn_seconds: Sysop ceiling for a table's turn_seconds (the play clock). 0 disables the clock on every table. Read by casino.config.get_max_turn_seconds.

big_win._comment_enabled: Announce big slots wins to every signed-in player on casino:global.
big_win._comment_multiplier: A spin whose payout is at least this many times the bet is a big win. Must be a whole number of 1 or more. Read by casino.config.get_big_win_settings.

auth.description: Disabled — bed AuthService (bed/api/auth.py) handles auth natively before any router loads. This placeholder modulepath does not resolve; kept for documentation.

bank.description: Disabled. bed's BankService (bed/api/bank.py) serves bank_* via engine.bed_bank_op. Enabling this shadows it with the direct-table handler.

postoffice.description: Postoffice service (IMAP mail polling and notifications) -- disabled pending integration

empyre.description: Empyre world building game (not yet implemented)

websocket._comment: WebSocket keepalive (seconds), forwarded to websockets.serve() by bed.main.BED.__init__. The websockets library default of 20s/20s is too aggressive for terminal clients (casino_client) whose main loop interleaves blocking stdin reads — pings go unanswered during those reads, the server hits the 20s timeout, and the next client send gets ConnectionClosedError 1011. 60s/600s gives the operator 10 minutes between actions before the server considers the connection dead.

startup_log._comment: File for the startup lines (startup completed / startup_failed). Empty path turns it off. Rotated by size; backups kept. zoid6.json carries the same keys.
